module.name: roksbnkctl-orphan-scan
module.description: Report IBM Cloud clusters, VPCs and Transit Gateways matching a name allowlist that no BNK Forge project owns. Read-only — it deletes nothing, and produces the inventory roksbnkctl-orphan-reap consumes.

required.name: name_prefixes
required.label: Name prefixes to consider (comma-separated)
required.description: ONLY resources whose name starts with one of these is even looked at. There is no default and blank is refused, because this account is shared — a scan here sees 21 ROKS clusters across nine regions belonging to other teams. 'Orphan' cannot mean 'not in Forge': almost nothing in this account is in Forge. It means 'matches a prefix you own AND no Forge project claims it'.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region to scan. Inherits from the credential template. VPCs and subnets are regional, so a scan only sees the region you point it at.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Filled from the project's credential template. Needs only read access to list clusters, VPCs and Transit Gateways.

optional.name: bnkforge_url
optional.label: BNK Forge URL
optional.description: Forge to ask which clusters are still owned. A cluster with a live project is BY DEFINITION not an orphan, however well its name matches. Leave blank and every prefix match is reported as unclaimed — useful for a dry look, dangerous as input to a reap.

optional.name: bnkforge_password
optional.label: BNK Forge password
optional.description: Passed as an environment variable only, never on the command line.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.label: Skip Forge TLS verification
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate.

key_outputs.name: orphan_count
key_outputs.description: Total orphans found. 0 means there is nothing to reap.

key_outputs.name: orphan_cluster_names
key_outputs.description: Comma-separated cluster names with no owning Forge project.

key_outputs.name: orphan_vpc_ids
key_outputs.description: Comma-separated VPC ids that match the allowlist and hold no live cluster.

key_outputs.name: orphan_gateway_ids
key_outputs.description: Comma-separated Transit Gateway ids that match the allowlist.
